title: X Hero Siege 4.0
summary: Version 4.0 is a systems and encounter update: Phase 3 bosses have been rebuilt with telegraphed pattern AI, runes and Fragment Quests add new match goals, and the HUD, end screen, Supporter Pass foundation, items, events, and hero implementations received a broad pass.

details.title: Highlights
items: Phase 3 boss fights were rebuilt around dynamic pattern AI, visible warning zones, cast bars, HP markers, counters, timers, and difficulty-scaled pressure.
Runes are now a match system with Recovery, Defense, Offense, and Misc categories that create short team or nearby power spikes.
Fragment Quests add optional objectives for healing, damage, potion discipline, event performance, boss kills, deaths, base health, orb variety, and more.
Supporter Pass groundwork is visible in-game through tier identity, fragments, XP progress, settings, profile elements, and end-screen displays.
The HUD and end screen were rebuilt with ally status, supporter marks, ankh/reincarnation visibility, event timers, special wave countdowns, and richer match stats.
Items and orbs received active/off states, new Arcane/Venom/Wind lines, refreshed orb scripting, and a large icon readability pass.

details.title: Phase 3 Boss Encounters
items: Phase 3 bosses now share encounter AI for target selection, cooldown handling, movement, pattern weighting, warning telegraphs, and difficulty scaling.
Boss mechanics stay recognizable across difficulties while damage, delays, density, thresholds, and recovery windows scale upward.
Boss bars now support cast bars, delayed health feedback, heal pulses, counters, timers, HP markers, multi-boss states, and special mechanics such as ankh counters.
Grom Hellscream now uses Mirror Trial, Blade Storm, Mirror Cleave, Windwalk Ambush, Warsong Leap, and Blood Frenzy.
Illidan now uses Fel Beam, Shadow Dash, Immolation Burst, Glaive Storm, and Metamorphosis pressure.
Balanar now uses Nightfall, Dread Howl, Sleeping Terror, Carrion Swarm, Rain of Chaos, and Vampiric Presence.
Proudmoore now uses Admiral's Command, Torrent Line, Broadside, Anchor Smash, and Focus Fire.
Arthas now uses Frostmourne Mark, Frozen Chains, Death Advance, and Frostmourne Execute.
The Lich King now uses Remorseless Winter, Frostmourne Hunger, Howling Blast, Glacial Spikes, Defile, Sindragosa Flyby, and Frozen Throne mechanics.
Spirit Master now has a multi-spirit structure built around Storm, Earth, Fire, and a coordinated final fight.
Banehallow now uses Soul Harvest, Shadow Line, Soul Rings, Meteor Hunt, Ragna Mark, Darkness, Requiem, Ghost Revenant management, and HP-threshold pressure.
Magtheridon now uses an ankh/reincarnation encounter loop with repeated kills, rupture fragments, respawn empowerment, and difficulty-scaled life counts.

details.title: Rune System
items: Runes now spawn as a match system with Recovery, Defense, Offense, and Misc visual categories.
Rune spawns are tied into special wave flow, show map/UI state, and can be claimed once per hero per batch.

Recovery runes:
- Healing Rune: team buff for 30 seconds, granting +5% health regen and +8% mana regen.
- Revitalization Rune: team buff for 20 seconds, reducing active cooldowns by 25% up to 20 seconds and granting +12% mana regen.
- Restoration Rune: instant team recovery for 35% of missing health and mana.
- Second Wind Rune: 30-second safety buff that triggers below 30% health, restores 30% health/mana over 3 seconds, and grants a short 20% guard window.

Defense runes:
- Barrier Rune: team buff for 30 seconds, granting a shield worth 25% max health and +4% regen.
- Retaliation Rune: nearby buff for 25 seconds, reflecting 25% of incoming damage.
- Bulwark Rune: nearby buff for 35 seconds, granting +35 armor and +25% magic resistance.
- Fortitude Rune: nearby buff for 25 seconds, granting +35% status resistance and reducing incoming damage by 20%.

Offense runes:
- Titan Rune: nearby buff for 35 seconds, granting +30% max health, +25% outgoing damage, and a larger model scale.
- Fury Rune: nearby buff for 30 seconds, granting +160 attack speed and +25% spell amplification.
- Siegebreaker Rune: nearby buff for 35 seconds, granting +45% damage against creeps and summons.
- Storm Rune: nearby buff for 30 seconds, striking up to 4 nearby enemies every 1.2 seconds for 550 damage.

Misc runes:
- Fragment Rune: instant picker reward tied to Supporter Fragments; currently configured for 50 fragments and flagged for backend validation before publication.
- Tome Rune: instant team reward granting +50 all stats.
- Bounty Surge Rune: team buff for 45 seconds, granting +35% shared creep bounty bonus.
- Momentum Rune: team buff for 45 seconds, granting +18% movement speed and +20% creep gold/XP.
Rune notifications now announce rune state, claims, expiration, category, and nearby availability.
Custom rune models and materials make rune type readable in the world, not only in UI text.

details.title: Fragment Quests
items: Fragment Quests are optional side objectives that can award stars and fragments during a match.
General team quests track War Healers, Coordinated Carnage, Potion Discipline, Potion Panic, Orbs of War, Frontline Pact, No Lane Falls, and Final Stand.
Event quests track Farm Event Mastery, Muradin Survivors, Ramero and Baristol, Sogat Slayer, Hero Image, All Hero Images, Spirit Beast, and Frost Infernal performance.
Boss and Phase 3 quests track Clean Assault, Grom Executed, Illidan Hunter, Lich King's End, and Spirit Master completion speed or survival rules.
Quest progress is pushed to the UI during the match with star states, objective progress, and reward feedback.
The end screen now shows confirmed Fragment Quest results and fragment gains.
Death-sensitive quests can count normal deaths and ankh/reincarnation deaths.

details.title: Supporter Pass Foundation
items: The Supporter Pass foundation is present in-game with player tier data, fragment wallet data, season XP, level progress, and public profile surfaces.
Supporter identity appears through tier marks, badges, colors, end-screen rows, top HUD elements, and Wisp-related supporter visuals.
Supporter vote power is wired into custom setup voting.
A Supporter Pass window exists with Rewards, Shop, Armory, Leaderboards, and Settings tabs.
Rewards, Shop, and Armory are treated as groundwork for 4.1 in the UI, so 4.0 should be presented as a foundation release rather than a fully launched shop.
Supporter settings include toggles for supporter identity, cosmetic reward display, XP visibility, and companion-related controls.

details.title: UI, HUD, And Quality Of Life
items: The top HUD was rebuilt with a fixed ally roster, health/mana state, hero status, supporter marks, tier crests, hover details, ankh charges, reincarnation state, event timers, and difficulty display.
Overhead status labels now surface important control states such as stunned, hexed, sleep, feared, taunted, cycloned, rooted, leashed, silenced, muted, disarmed, broken, and invulnerable.
The boss health bar now supports multi-boss fights, cast bars, counters, timers, HP threshold markers, ankh badges, and clearer heal/damage feedback.
The notification layer was expanded with top and bottom toasts, reward flyouts, rune indicators, Fragment Quest star feedback, special wave countdowns, and main quest completion messaging.
The end screen now summarizes MVP-style categories such as kills, tome stats, potion usage, boss damage, damage taken, and self-healing.
End-screen player rows now include richer stats such as net worth, boss damage, damage taken, healing, self-healing, tomes, supporter tier, and pass progress.
Custom game setup was cleaned around Reborn mode, difficulty voting, ready-up flow, vote progress, and safer player vote handling.
A buy-max-small-tomes shortcut was added and routed through server-side validation, with restrictions during events or locked arenas.

details.title: Special Events And Match Flow
items: Muradin, Farm Event, Ramero and Baristol, and Sogat now connect into the newer timer, notification, reward, rune, and Fragment Quest systems.
Optional encounters such as Hero Image, All Hero Images, Spirit Beast, and Frost Infernal now have clearer personal timers, return markers, win/fail cleanup, and Fragment Quest hooks.
Event transitions use more controlled teleport and cinematic pause flows.
Tome purchasing and special wave behavior are restricted during specific arenas and events.
Reward flyouts and event timer messaging make event outcomes more visible without relying on hidden state.

details.title: Items And Orbs
items: Orb items received a large active/off visual pass, including refreshed item icons and modifier icons.
The Arcane orb line adds spell amp, mana sustain, mana cost reduction, cooldown reduction at higher tiers, and active Arcane Exposure that lowers enemy magic resistance after spells.
The Venom orb line adds attack poison, damage over time, armor reduction at higher tiers, and bonus magic damage when hitting already poisoned enemies.
The Wind orb line adds evasion and movement speed, with upgraded evasion procs that grant movement speed and later damage reduction.
Earth orb scripting was refreshed around active bash behavior while keeping the line focused on heavy damage and stun pressure.
Darkness orb scripting was rebuilt around active conversion of slain eligible enemies into temporary controlled units, with higher-tier survivability and damage stats.
Item image coverage was expanded for Arcane, Venom, Wind, Earth, Darkness, Fire, Frost, Lightning, major utility items, and active/off states.

details.title: Heroes And Abilities
items: Archmage now has a Lua Mana Shield implementation that spends mana to absorb incoming damage and turns itself off when mana cannot sustain it.
Centurion gained Lua implementations for Necromastery and Atrophy Aura, adding soul-based damage scaling and enemy damage suppression themes.
Huntress gained safer lightning ability handling with bounce logic, particle feedback, sound, spell absorb handling, and no-repeat target behavior.
Mountain Giant received a major implementation pass for Craggy Exterior, Earth Splitter, Stone Gaze, growth/model handling, and Toss cleanup.
Priestess of the Moon received a small Rejuvenation reliability pass.
Wisp received a safer random-hero replacement flow, starting item/gold handling, command restrictions during replacement, and supporter-colored ambient visuals.
Spirit Master received ability logic for Overload, Ball Lightning, transformation handling, cooldown preservation, tome stat preservation, and remnant/modifier cleanup.
Lich abilities received Lua work for Frost Arrows and Summon Frost Beast, including projectile behavior, attack record handling, slow logic, and visual growth handling.
Additional hero files were touched for smaller ability ports, cleanup, talent/tooltip alignment, or implementation fixes; exact balance claims should be reviewed before publication.

details.title: Technical And Content Pipeline
items: NPC unit data was split into focused files for bosses, events, buildings, summons, wave creeps, special encounters, neutral dragons, allies, VIPs, and dummy units.
A central precache component was added for bosses, items, runes, UI assets, and other common content groups.
Custom net table coverage was expanded for runes, Fragment Quests, supporter pass data, overhead status, timers, end-screen stats, and other UI-driven systems.
Internal devtools were added for faster testing and iteration.
Loading screen and game info assets were refreshed for the 4.0 flow.
GitHub/Discord workflow scripts were updated, but these are release operations changes rather than player-facing gameplay content.

details.title: Needs Review Before Publishing
items: Supporter Pass wording needs confirmation: Rewards, Shop, and Armory are visible in UI, but the UI marks them as available in 4.1.
Supporter tier prices, monthly fragments, XP boosts, and vote power should be confirmed before listing exact commercial values.
Fragment Rune reward behavior should only be promised publicly after server-side reward validation is confirmed.
Many hero files changed, but several look like ports, cleanup, tooltip work, or implementation fixes; verify exact buff/nerf wording in gameplay review.
Phase 3 boss values should be published only after final balance validation because several boss tooltips are still generic.
The release audit should be regenerated if the v4.0 branch moves before publication.

details.title: Release audit
items: Diff analyzed: 820 files, 31 commits, +101,776 / -25,107 lines.

entries.title: Fragment Quests
items: Introduces a match-long team objective board. Each game selects a set of Fragment Quests, with progress and milestone notifications shown in-game.
Quest pools cover team damage and healing, potion discipline or emergency potion use, survival, base defense, special events, boss kills, and timed phase challenges.
Every completed threshold awards stars; each star converts into Supporter Fragments. Results, stars, and confirmed rewards carry through to the end screen.
Some objectives track reincarnation and ankh deaths as well as normal deaths, so their requirements reflect the full match state.

entries.title: Rune System
items: Introduces map runes as coordinated special-wave rewards. Batches draw from Recovery, Defense, Offense, and Misc pools, with distinct world models and colors.
A rune window can spawn multiple pickup points, but each hero may claim only one rune from that batch. This makes route choice and team coordination matter.
The HUD communicates the active rune type, category, claim state, nearby availability, and expiration while the reward is on the map.
The four rune categories and all sixteen effects are detailed below.

entries.title: Supporter Pass Foundation
items: Introduces the in-game Supporter Pass foundation: tier identity, fragment balance, seasonal XP, level progress, vote power, and account-facing status.
Supporter markers and tier crests are integrated into the HUD, profile surfaces, cosmetic effects, and the end-of-match presentation.
The pass UI exposes current progression and reward tracks. Rewards, Shop, and Armory remain 4.1 groundwork and are not presented as a completed 4.0 feature.

entries.title: End Screen
items: Introduces a full post-match screen rather than a basic scoreboard: kills, tome statistics, potion usage, boss damage, damage taken, self-healing, net worth, and supporter progress are presented together.
The result screen also resolves Fragment Quest stars and rewards, so the team can see its objective outcome before leaving the match.

entries.title: Notifications
items: Introduces a unified match notification layer for top and bottom toasts, reward flyouts, rune alerts, Fragment Quest stars, special-wave countdowns, and quest completion.
Special events use the same layer to explain timers, teleport and return flow, and rewards at the moment they matter.

entries.title: Top HUD
items: Introduces an expanded ally and match-status HUD: health, mana, hero state, supporter marks, tier crests, ankh charges, reincarnation state, event timers, and difficulty context are visible in one place.
It also adds explicit overhead control-state labels for stun, hex, fear, root, silence, break, and invulnerability.

changelogRules: Entries inside a category are displayed alphabetically by title.
Hero and unit ability changes use a second hierarchy: entity, then ability section, then ability entries.
Internal Lua rewrites are not player-facing notes unless they change visible behavior, repair ability behavior, or add readable combat mechanics.
Potential bug fixes inferred from code need visible gameplay evidence or manual review before being labeled as fixes.
